weapons.name: Arcanethyst
weapons.special: Arcane Assault - on-hit chance levitates the target; the active lifts nearby medium enemies with arcane force for a moment, then slams them into the ground.

weapons.name: Awakened Lichblade
weapons.special: Soul Anguish III - same soul ability at the final awakening tier (strongest souls, damage and absorption).

weapons.name: Bloodwake
weapons.special: Crimson Revelry - hits inflict Bleed; striking a max-Bleed enemy bursts for area bleed damage and grants Blood Frenzy, which is spent to invoke escalating blood rites up to the Red Tide wave, and bloodstains slow enemies while healing you.

weapons.name: Bramblethorn
weapons.special: Grasp of the Wild - the active sends a living bramble that binds the target and nearby enemies so damage echoes between them; on-hit a bramble travels from the previous target to the new one, damaging and slowing along its path.

weapons.name: Brimstone Claymore
weapons.special: Brimstone - chance on hit to spew explosive brimstone; the active summons a Brimstone Claymore above the target that pulses area fire damage before plunging into the ground.

weapons.name: Caelestis
weapons.special: Astral Breach - tears open a dimensional breach that expands and summons friendly corrupted creatures (with a chance to release an Unbound hunter) before collapsing and pulling them back.

weapons.name: Chomp'olotl
weapons.special: Chompocalypse - hits summon axolotls that fight nearby enemies (and can perch on your shoulders for area buffs); the active summons a swarm including a rare blue axolotl.

weapons.name: Dawnquiver
weapons.special: Seraph's Draw - a lesser bow periodically fires at your most distant visible enemy and can build Dawn Chorus; holding draws a great bow whose arrow scales with draw time and spends Chorus on Dawn Volley, Sunlance or Seraphic Chorus.

weapons.name: Dreadwhisper
weapons.special: Shadow Rend - hits leave a Corrupted Wound; striking a wounded target guarantees a critical hit and ruptures the wound; the active surges through enemies leaving Gloam and healing a share of damage dealt.

weapons.name: Emberblade
weapons.special: Ember Ire - hold to channel; release fires fiery shrapnel at the aimed target with damage scaling by channel time (an extra shrapnel on a last-second release) and a chance for Speed, Haste and Strength.

weapons.name: Emberlash
weapons.special: Smoulder - attacks inflict Smouldering for bonus damage per stack; the active evades backwards while cauterising the wound, healing a percentage of max health.

weapons.name: Enigma
weapons.special: Galeforce - the active summons a twister that chases nearby enemies, dealing more damage the longer they stay inside; standing near it grants Haste.

weapons.name: Flamewind
weapons.special: Emberstorm - the active plants a flame seed in the nearest enemy for damage over time; on expiry it detonates for area damage and spreads to nearby enemies, and each detonation grants Haste.

weapons.name: Frostfall
weapons.special: Frost Fury - thrown with impact scaling by airtime and angle; on landing it pulses five times, damaging, slowing and pulling enemies; innate Loyalty III.

weapons.name: Gloampiercer
weapons.special: Phantom Phalanx - swinging at an enemy 3-12 blocks away summons an airborne shadow clone that hurls an explosive spear; the active lifts you and bombards the area with Gloam spears.

weapons.name: Harbinger
weapons.special: Abyssal Standard - on-hit chance inflicts weakness; the active plants a standard that pulls, damages and slows enemies while periodically granting Haste to nearby allies.

weapons.name: Hearthflame
weapons.special: Chains of the Furnace - hits brand and ignite; the active binds nearby enemies with molten chains that echo fire damage between them and build pressure until every chain shatters for area damage.

weapons.name: Hiveheart
weapons.special: Hivemind - hits release a stinging bee; the active releases a swarm of tiny bees that repeatedly slows and damages nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Icewhisper
weapons.special: Permafrost - a passive frost aura damages and slows enemies around you; the active calls ice comets down around you for area damage.

weapons.name: Ionbound Stormscale
weapons.special: Ion Containment - cubes recharge and negate a single large hit as a 2s shield; the active consumes a cube to raise a corridor that pulls enemies in and slams shut, then channels a steerable beam that damages and paralyses.

weapons.name: Livyatan
weapons.special: Leviathan's Wake - thrown (impact scales with airtime); on return it creates a wave that pulls enemies with a chance of lightning strikes, and swings release damaging waves; innate Loyalty III.

weapons.name: Magiblade
weapons.special: Magisonic - passively detects and repels approaching enemies; after charging, summons an orbiting Warden head that periodically fires sonic waves at nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Magiscythe
weapons.special: Magistorm - the active manifests a localised magic storm above you that strikes nearby enemies, each strike having a chance to refresh its duration and raise its severity; attacking while it is up can repair an equipped item.

weapons.name: Magispear
weapons.special: Magislam - on-hit chance deals bonus magic damage; the active launches the spear skyward to rain magic spears, then leaps (immune) to the target area for a final slam.

weapons.name: Mjolnir
weapons.special: Storm - hits make enemies Conductive (they release a thunderclap when struck); the active summons a mobile storm that repeatedly bolts nearby enemies and ends in a thunderclap.

weapons.name: Molten Edge
weapons.special: Furnace Heart - dealing and taking damage builds Heat (increasing damage dealt and received); at maximum Heat you deal +50%, take +100% and ignite, and the active vents a molten shockwave while swings release magma ruptures.

weapons.name: Ribboncleaver
weapons.special: Ribbonwrath - wielding costs 5% movement speed but grants 15% damage reduction; the active dashes forward ignoring the next hits, gaining knockback resistance, and makes your next attack deal +95% to one target.

weapons.name: Riftmane
weapons.special: Vanguard - chance on swing to tear a rift that looses a spectral charger at a distant foe; the active opens a rank of chargers that surge forward, goring and scattering everything in their path.

weapons.name: Righteous Relic
weapons.special: Righteous Standard - on-hit chance regenerates health; the active plants a standard that ignites, damages and slows enemies while periodically granting Strength and healing to nearby allies.

weapons.name: Shadowsting
weapons.special: Shadow Dance - on-hit chance summons a shadow clone that repeats your attack; the active grants brief immunity and shadowsteps between nearby enemies, striking each for weapon damage.

weapons.name: Slumbering Lichblade
weapons.special: Soul Anguish I - passive souls radiate from you damaging nearby enemies; the active commands them to rapidly strike a distant target (chance to siphon health), then returns them to grant absorption.

weapons.name: Soulkeeper
weapons.special: Soul Meld - two soul lanterns orbit and damage enemies they touch, speeding up as you land hits; the active temporarily summons two more lanterns.

weapons.name: Soul Pyre
weapons.special: Soul Tether - the ground around you becomes nether terrain that grows with each kill, granting 50% damage reduction and knockback resistance, while defeated enemies become homing soul projectiles.

weapons.name: Soulrender
weapons.special: Soul Rend - hits stack weakening marks; the active consumes the stacks of all nearby foes, damaging them and healing you per stack consumed.

weapons.name: Soulstalker
weapons.special: Stygian Stride - abyssal limbs lift you to stride over terrain and charge-jump; footsteps spread Gloam, swings release shadow cleaves, and tendrils periodically pierce nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Soulstealer
weapons.special: Soul Steal - hits and kills steal soul debt; the active spends all debt to blink behind the target and backstab for up to 5x weapon damage.

weapons.name: Star's Edge
weapons.special: Astral Reprise - bonus damage by day and lifesteal by night; the active dashes forward leaving a constellation trail that damages on contact and explodes each star for area damage on expiry.

weapons.name: Stormbringer
weapons.special: Shock Deflect - hold to focus the blade (brief damage immunity); a well-timed release counters the attacker and grants Storm Charges, each spent on hit to chain lightning between nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Storm's Edge
weapons.special: Stormbreak - turn into lightning and dash forward with invulnerability, tearing through enemies and releasing a thunderclap, then keep lingering Speed and Haste; hits can refresh the cooldown.

weapons.name: Stormscale
weapons.special: Lightning Rod - the active plants a spectral glaive that pulses area lightning whenever you land a melee hit, each hit adding 1% pulse damage and radius up to 80%.

weapons.name: Sunfire
weapons.special: Righteous Standard - on-hit chance regenerates health; the active plants a standard that ignites, damages and slows enemies while periodically granting Strength and healing to nearby allies.

weapons.name: Sword on a Stick
weapons.special: Joke unique: a throwable sword on a stick with innate Loyalty III, so it can be hurled and returns.

weapons.name: Tainted Relic
weapons.special: Abyssal Standard - on-hit chance inflicts weakness; the active plants a standard that pulls, damages and slows enemies while periodically granting Haste to nearby allies.

weapons.name: Tempest
weapons.special: Vortex - attacks attach stacking elemental energy (damage over time plus element-specific debuffs); the active recalls all nearby elements into a growing vortex that damages enemies around you.

weapons.name: The Devourer
weapons.special: Devouring Mass - deflecting an attack opens an abyssal maw that damages and drags enemies toward its core; the active launches an abyssal seed that blooms into a living, feeding mass.

weapons.name: Thunderbrand
weapons.special: Thunder Blitz - hold to charge while immune to damage; the release dashes through enemies and fires a chain-lightning bolt for each hit absorbed, and hits can refresh the cooldown.

weapons.name: Longsword of the Plague
weapons.special: Death Knell - hits build Fever; at the threshold a plague bell tolls for area damage, spreads Fever and cascades through nearby enemies, and positive effects on the victim are converted into ailments for bonus Fever.

weapons.name: Twisted Blade
weapons.special: Ferocity - hits grant stacking Ferocity (attack speed) and trigger Crescendo area strikes; the active consumes all stacks so the next hit becomes a Grand Crescendo with scaling damage, radius and knockback.

weapons.name: Waking Lichblade
weapons.special: Soul Anguish II - same soul ability as the Slumbering Lichblade at the second awakening tier (stronger souls, damage and absorption).

weapons.name: The Watcher
weapons.special: Final Omen - hits build Dread and summon bats; the active looses a bat barrage that repeatedly tears the target and executes enemies left below a health threshold at maximum Dread.

weapons.name: Watching Warglaive
weapons.special: Night Pursuit - releases Dread-marked bats that hunt nearby enemies, striking them and siphoning life for every Dread stack consumed.

weapons.name: Waxweaver
weapons.special: Waxweave - hits on burning enemies grant Strength and Haste; the active encases an enemy in wax (immobile and taunted by its allies) which detonates on expiry or death, and on lethal damage you are revived in wax at full health.

weapons.name: Whisperwind
weapons.special: Fatal Flicker - dash forward gaining Resistance and Absorption, with enemies in the path taking damage after a short delay; hits can refresh the cooldown.

weapons.name: Wickpiercer
weapons.special: Flicker Fury - thrown with innate Loyalty III; throwing grants up to 5 Frenzy stacks that raise attack speed and allow double hits, and stacks are lost when you are hit.

weapons.name: Wraithfang
weapons.special: Spectral Leap - throw Wraithfang and leap to it, briefly immune, gaining Haste on arrival; innate Loyalty I.

weapons.name: Wraithmaw
weapons.special: Spectral Downpour - collected spectral cutlasses float above you and seek targets when you swing; the active sends a barrage of cutlasses that leave Gloam where they land.
